changes: Ported from JavaScript to C#. The Pillar Colors and Mod Defaults config buttons are gone because C# configs have no buttons: use /cdt pillar and /cdt reset. Header colors and greyed-out rows are gone too, so the Held Item Class colors are always shown; a change there only counts while holding a weapon of a modded class. Colors of other mods' classes moved to coloreddamagetypes.CrossModDamageTypes.txt in the game's save folder, as plain text, because C# mods have no mod data folder and no JSON library: colors saved by the JavaScript version are not read. Mod.Call colors accept #RRGGBB, a Color or an array of three numbers. In multiplayer on a phone host (netMode 3), the host now passes hit packets on, shows its clients' numbers and announces its own hits; the JavaScript version tested netMode 1 and 2 only.
